# Kingherbs

> Kingherbs is a global manufacturer and supplier of herbal extracts, botanical powders, and natural ingredients for dietary supplements and food applications.

Kingherbs Limited specializes in producing high-quality herbal extracts and fruit powders with rigorous quality standards (USP, EP, BP, CP). The company operates across multiple languages and regions, with a strong presence in China (Hunan province) and serves international markets with traceability and organic cultivation practices.

## Key Topics

- Herbal Extracts
- Botanical Ingredients
- Natural Products
- Dietary Supplements
- Quality Standards (USP, EP, BP, CP)
- Vine Tea Extract
- Mulberry Leaf Extract Powder
- Polygonum Cuspidatum Extract
- Organic Cultivation
- Manufacturer & Supplier
- Food Additives
- Plant-Based Products
- Kingherbs Limited
- China/Hunan
- Traceability
